video_title: All-Access: Senior Men's National Team Training Camp

quotes.speaker: Rowan Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: Rowan Barrett on the importance of commitment to Canadian basketball
quotes.excerpt: Without commitment there's nothing, doesn't matter what we do. Focus on what we can give.
quotes.quote: This is notoriously one of the most difficult moments of our quad, this first window here in the summer, just because of the proximity to your seasons. Our country won't win unless you guys want it to win. Our goal is what I shared with you, to win. Talked about it, without commitment there's nothing, doesn't matter what we do. Focus on what we can give.

quotes.speaker: Gordie Herbert
quotes.summary_phrase: Gordie Herbert emphasizes the need for a team-first mentality
quotes.excerpt: We have elite individuals in this room, a lot of them, but we need to create the team mentality first.
quotes.quote: We have elite individuals in this room, a lot of them, but we need to create the team mentality first. We don't play the other way.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the importance of team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Just kind of getting our win back, I think that's most important.
quotes.quote: Just kind of getting our win back, I think that's most important. We played with each other before, we know each other's tendencies. We just kind of get back into game shape.

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on the honor of playing for Canada
quotes.excerpt: Getting to play for your country is a big honor and it means a lot.
quotes.quote: Getting to play for your country is a big honor and it means a lot. But when you have a good group of guys and you laugh, you get along and you get to enjoy the game you love, it's fun.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Nembhard
quotes.summary_phrase: Andrew Nembhard on the joy of returning to the national team
quotes.excerpt: Some of the most fun moments I had growing up was playing for the national team.
quotes.quote: Some of the most fun moments I had growing up was playing for the national team. So it's nice to kind of see a bunch of different faces that I've known for a long time and get a chance to compete with my bro.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on the opportunity to represent Canada
quotes.excerpt: Every time that opportunity shows up, I'm going to take it.
quotes.quote: Every time that opportunity shows up, I'm going to take it. And so it was a blessing for me to be able to put on this jersey.

quotes.speaker: Mfiondu Kabengele
quotes.summary_phrase: Mfiondu Kabengele on the team's physical and mental toughness
quotes.excerpt: We're not going to get bumped off our line, we're not going to fold or bend.
quotes.quote: It's the physicality, the pace, the determination, the will with us. You know, we're not going to get bumped off our line, we're not going to fold or bend. We're just going to continue to do what we need to do.

quotes.speaker: Gordie Herbert
quotes.summary_phrase: Gordie Herbert on the roster selection process and commitment
quotes.excerpt: We gotta pick 12 guys to play the first game. Everybody's gonna stay here.
quotes.quote: What we're doing is we're going to, we gotta pick 12 guys to play the first game. Everybody's gonna stay here. And there might be some changes after the first game. There might be some injuries, different stuff. But we'd like everybody to stay here to be part of the team. Guys have sacrificed to be here, so be here.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on communication and intensity
quotes.excerpt: Wish we had a little bit more communication when you get tired, I think AB said it best.

text_blocks.text: Wish we had a little bit more communication when you get tired, I think AB said it best.
